10k.note: 10-K identifies three lead drug candidates: NRX-100 (preservative-free IV ketamine), KETAFREE (generic preservative-free ketamine ANDA), and NRX-101 (oral fixed-dose D-cycloserine + lurasidone). Subsidiary HOPE Therapeutics provides interventional psychiatry services.

website.note: Pipeline page references Bipolar Depression with suicidal ideation as lead indication; full asset detail rendered via JS table not extracted by WebFetch. Confirmed via 10-K and IR press releases.

ctgov.note: No active P1-P3 trials returned for sponsor 'NRX Pharmaceuticals' on clinicaltrials.gov. Path forward for NRX-100 is NDA via Real World Evidence (per March 2026 Type C FDA meeting); NRX-101 has Breakthrough Therapy Designation and an amended IND for TMS-augmentation indication but no enrolling registrational trial yet.
